title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to award a firm fixed price Contract No. PS141682000 with International Business Machines Corporation (IBM) to provide…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0788, Contract]
[FINANCE, BUDGET, AND AUDIT COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (4-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to award a firm fixed price Contract No. PS141682000 with International Business Machines Corporation (IBM) to provide Supplemental Technology Support Services in the amount of $5,370,000 for the three-year base term, which includes Phase 1 (Information Technology) and Phase 2 (Operations Technology), and $3,090,000 for a two-year option to continue services, for a total not-to-exceed amount of $8,460,000, subject to the resolution of any properly submitted protest(s), if any.
summary: Metro would award IBM a contract for supplemental technology support services, up to $8.46 million including a two-year option.
